input.quote: 3.1 The Company shall pay HDI thirty percent (3016) of the Net Sales in excess of Eleven Thousand Dollars ($11,000) per calendar month.
input.rationale: Searches for most-favoured-nation, "no less favourable", best-terms, matching, discount and comparable pricing language return nothing. The only economic terms are the fixed revenue-share in Section 3 (Fees; Payment), which contains no obligation for the Company to extend HDI terms equal to or better than those given to any third party, and no obligation to match third-party offers. Section 6.1 restricts the Company from participating in similar Internet projects and grants HDI exclusive use of the "Deerskin" brand online, but that is an exclusivity/non-compete term rather than an MFN pricing obligation and is addressed under the exclusivity rule, not here. The document therefore sits at the preferred position (no MFN obligation burdening the Company); no redline required.
